P-ENCLOSURE.evidence: Tall white walls on both sides and a trellis define clear vertical edges, creating a corridor-like enclosed outdoor room.

P-LAYERS.evidence: Planting includes tall vine on trellis, mid-height shrubs, and low ground plants with flowers, creating visible vertical layering and lushness.
